text:
You need a real-time object detection solution that can use a mobile camera, identify objects accurately, and be ready for production integration.

I’m Noor Halden, and I have 6 years of experience building machine learning and computer vision solutions. For this kind of work, I’d focus on creating a reliable detection pipeline that is optimized for fast inference, clean integration, and practical use in a mobile app environment. My background includes Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, and machine learning, with direct experience in camera-based detection systems.

One project that is highly relevant is Ceramic tile defect detection for Halvorsen Ceramics. I built a camera-based crack and chip detector that was exported to ONNX and run on an industrial PC beside the kiln line. That system achieved 97.4% recall on cracks and reduced false rejects from 8% to 2.1%. This project required working with visual data, improving detection performance, and delivering a deployable model in a real production setting.

For your project, I can help design and develop the object recognition model, train and fine-tune it on the available data, and evaluate performance carefully so the output is dependable enough for real-time use. I also write clean, readable, well-documented code, which is important when a model needs to be maintained, tested, and integrated with other parts of a mobile application.

I understand the importance of both accuracy and speed in real-time object detection. Just as important, I can communicate the technical tradeoffs clearly so the system can be aligned with product goals and non-technical stakeholders can understand the choices being made.

If helpful, I can also provide an example of real-time object detection by camera as requested, and then discuss the best approach for integrating the model into your native iOS-Android app.
